pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of averaging down or pyramiding into correlated positions within a 10-pip window; mandatory minimum +$10 floating profit on foundational layer before scaling.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: ATR(14) volatility expansion filter coupled with Order Flow Imbalance confirmation to prevent entry into low-liquidity sweep wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10, trail remainder with a tighter structural step-stop to capture asymmetric $15-$30+ runs.
